learning_outcomes.text: The students will be acquainted with the basis of Linear Elastic FractureMechanics.
The great attention is devoted too the problems of High-Cycle Fatigue .

syllabus_topics: Types of material failure. Constructional and structural notches.
Notches and stress concentration. Stress concentration factor, stress gradient.
Linear elastic stress analysis of cracks.
Modes of fracture. Stress intensity factor.
Brittle fracture. Mechanical properties of materials.
Linear elastic fracture mechanics. Griffith, s criterium. Sih,s criterium.
S-N curves. The factors effects of Fatigue Limit.
Prediction approach of high cyclic fatigue lifetime. Fatigue moduls (summary).
bibliography: DOWLING, N. E. Mechanical behavior of materials: engineering methods for deformation, fracture, and fatigue. Englewood Cliffs: Prentice Hall, c1993. ISBN 0-13-026956-5.
SURESH, S. Fatigue of materials. 2nd ed. New York: Cambridge University Press, 1998. ISBN 0-521-57847-7.
